requirements.title: Platform must meet SOC 2 Type II, CCPA/CPRA, GDPR and ISO 27001 obligations
requirements.description: The B2B SaaS platform is governed by four named external frameworks: SOC 2 Type II covering the Security, Availability and Confidentiality trust services categories; the CCPA as amended by the CPRA; GDPR; and ISO 27001. Engineering and product teams must design and operate controls that satisfy all four.
requirements.quote: SOC 2 Type II (Security, Availability, Confidentiality), CCPA as amended by CPRA, GDPR, ISO 27001

requirements.title: Control objectives paraphrased rather than reproducing copyrighted AICPA criteria
requirements.description: Compliance documentation must express control objectives in the organisation's own words. The AICPA Trust Services Criteria are copyrighted material and must not be reproduced verbatim in internal briefs.
requirements.quote: this brief paraphrases control objectives in the organisation's own words. The AICPA Trust Services Criteria themselves are copyrighted and are not reproduced here.

requirements.title: Compliance requirements brief targeted at engineering and product teams
requirements.description: The compliance requirements summary is a formal document type addressed to Engineering and Product teams, with an effective date of 2024, so that implementation teams have an authoritative statement of applicable obligations.
requirements.quote:
**Document Type:** Compliance Requirements Summary
**Audience:** Engineering & Product Teams
**Effective Date:** 2024

requirements.title: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria in scope: Security, Availability, Confidentiality
requirements.description: The platform's SOC 2 Type II report must cover the Security criteria (mandatory) plus the Availability and Confidentiality criteria. Controls must be designed and operated to satisfy all three categories.
requirements.quote: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria: Security (required), Availability, Confidentiality

requirements.title: California privacy law applies as CCPA amended by CPRA
requirements.description: The platform is subject to the California Consumer Privacy Act as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act, and compliance requirements derive from that amended statute.
requirements.quote: California Consumer Privacy Act as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act

requirements.title: GDPR applies to processing of EU data subject personal data
requirements.description: Where the platform processes personal data belonging to EU data subjects, GDPR obligations apply and must be met.
requirements.quote: GDPR, where the platform processes personal data of EU data subjects

requirements.title: ISO 27001 Annex A applies where contractually required
requirements.description: ISO 27001 Annex A controls are in scope where enterprise customers impose them as a contractual requirement.
requirements.quote: ISO 27001 Annex A, where enterprise customers require it contractually

requirements.title: Type II report observation period is 6 or 12 months
requirements.description: A SOC 2 Type II report covers a defined period of time, typically either 6 months or 12 months, rather than a point in time.
requirements.quote: A Type II report covers a period, typically 6 or 12 months.

requirements.title: Controls must demonstrate consistent operation throughout the period
requirements.description: It is not sufficient for controls to exist; evidence must show that each control operated consistently across the entire audit observation period.
requirements.quote: Controls must not only exist but be shown to have operated consistently throughout.

requirements.title: Retrospectively created evidence is not acceptable
requirements.description: Evidence must be captured contemporaneously as controls operate. Evidence assembled after the fact does not count toward demonstrating control operation.
requirements.quote: Evidence gathered after the fact is not evidence.

requirements.title: Multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform compliance scope
requirements.description: The compliance program applies to a multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform, meaning controls must address tenant separation alongside the named frameworks.
requirements.quote: This document sets out the compliance requirements for a multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform pursuing a SOC 2 Type II report and subject to California privacy law.

requirements.title: Least privilege access to production systems and customer data
requirements.description: Access to production systems and customer data must be granted on a least-privilege basis and revoked promptly once it is no longer needed.
requirements.quote: Access to production systems and customer data is granted on least privilege and removed promptly when no longer required.

requirements.title: Single sign-on required for all internal access
requirements.description: All internal access must use single sign-on. Local accounts are prohibited except for documented break-glass accounts.
requirements.quote: Single sign-on for all internal access; local accounts prohibited except for documented break-glass

requirements.title: MFA mandatory for production access
requirements.description: Multi-factor authentication must be enforced for all production access, with no exceptions permitted.
requirements.quote: Multi-factor authentication required for production access without exception

requirements.title: System owner approval, no self-approval of access
requirements.description: Every access request must be approved by the system owner; requesters may never approve their own access.
requirements.quote: Access requests approved by the system owner, never self-approved

requirements.title: Quarterly access reviews of every production system
requirements.description: Access reviews must be performed each quarter and must cover every production system.
requirements.quote: Quarterly access reviews covering every production system

requirements.title: Deprovisioning within 24 hours of termination
requirements.description: Access must be removed within 24 hours of a termination, and immediately in the case of involuntary termination.
requirements.quote: Deprovisioning within 24 hours of termination; immediate for involuntary termination

requirements.title: Ticket evidence for every access grant
requirements.description: For Type II evidence, each access grant must have a ticket recording the requester, the approver and the business justification.
requirements.quote: Ticket for every access grant, showing requester, approver and business justification

requirements.title: Quarterly review artefacts for every quarter in the period
requirements.description: For Type II evidence, access review artefacts must record the reviewer identity and date, and must exist for every quarter in the audit period.
requirements.quote: Quarterly review artefacts with reviewer identity and date, for every quarter in the period

requirements.title: Termination records reconciled to deprovisioning timestamps
requirements.description: For Type II evidence, termination records must be matched against deprovisioning timestamps, showing the elapsed gap for each termination.
requirements.quote: Termination records matched against deprovisioning timestamps, showing the gap for each

requirements.title: Production changes are authorised, tested and traceable
requirements.description: All changes deployed to production must be authorised, tested and fully traceable back to their source.
requirements.quote: Changes to production are authorised, tested and traceable.

requirements.title: All production changes originate from version control
requirements.description: Every production change must come from version control; direct edits to production are prohibited.
requirements.quote: All production changes originate from version control; no direct edits

requirements.title: Peer review required before merge with author separation
requirements.description: Each change must be peer reviewed before merge, and the change author is not permitted to approve their own change.
requirements.quote: Peer review required before merge; the author may not approve their own change

requirements.title: Automated tests must pass before deployment
requirements.description: Deployment is blocked unless the automated test suite passes for the change.
requirements.quote: Automated tests must pass before deployment

requirements.title: Emergency changes reviewed retrospectively within 3 business days
requirements.description: Emergency changes may bypass the standard pre-approval flow but must undergo retrospective review within 3 business days.
requirements.quote: Emergency changes permitted, with retrospective review within 3 business days

requirements.title: Rollback plan documented for data structure changes
requirements.description: Any change that affects data structure must have a documented rollback plan.
requirements.quote: Rollback plan documented for changes affecting data structure

requirements.title: Pull request history with reviewer identity as evidence
requirements.description: The system must retain pull request history showing reviewer identity, sampleable across the audit period.
requirements.quote: Pull request history showing reviewer identity, for a sample across the period

requirements.title: Deployment log linked to originating change
requirements.description: Deployment logs must be tied to the specific change that produced the deployment.
requirements.quote: Deployment log tied to the change that produced it

requirements.title: Emergency change register with retrospective approvals
requirements.description: An emergency change register must be maintained recording each emergency change and its retrospective approval.
requirements.quote: Emergency change register with retrospective approvals

requirements.title: 99.9% monthly uptime commitment
requirements.description: The service must maintain a monthly uptime of 99.9%, measured excluding scheduled maintenance windows.
requirements.quote: Uptime commitment 99.9% monthly, measured excluding scheduled maintenance

requirements.title: Scheduled maintenance notice period
requirements.description: Scheduled maintenance must be announced to customers at least 5 business days before it takes place.
requirements.quote: Scheduled maintenance announced at least 5 business days in advance

requirements.title: Recovery time objective of 4 hours
requirements.description: Service recovery following an outage must be achieved within a recovery time objective of 4 hours.
requirements.quote: Recovery time objective 4 hours; recovery point objective 1 hour

requirements.title: Recovery point objective of 1 hour
requirements.description: Data loss in a recovery scenario must not exceed 1 hour, per the stated recovery point objective.
requirements.quote: Recovery time objective 4 hours; recovery point objective 1 hour

requirements.title: Daily automated backups retained 35 days
requirements.description: The system must perform automated backups daily and retain each backup for 35 days.
requirements.quote: Automated backups daily, retained 35 days

requirements.title: Quarterly real restore testing
requirements.description: Restores must be tested every quarter using an actual restore of data, not merely a checksum verification.
requirements.quote: Restore tested quarterly against a real restore, not a checksum

requirements.title: 24/7 monitoring with on-call alerting
requirements.description: Monitoring must be in place with alerting routed to an on-call rota available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
requirements.quote: Monitoring with alerting to an on-call rota, 24/7

requirements.title: Defined incident severity levels with response targets
requirements.description: Incident severity levels must be defined, each with an associated response time target.
requirements.quote: Incident severity levels defined, with response time targets per level

requirements.title: Monthly uptime reports as evidence
requirements.description: Uptime reports must be produced and available for every month within the reporting period.
requirements.quote: Uptime reports for every month in the period

requirements.title: Restore test records with date and outcome
requirements.description: Quarterly restore test records must be retained as evidence, recording the date of the test and its outcome.
requirements.quote: Restore test records, quarterly, with the date and outcome

requirements.title: Incident records capture detection, response and resolution
requirements.description: Incident records must be maintained as evidence showing detection time, response time and resolution.
requirements.quote: Incident records showing detection time, response time and resolution

requirements.title: Tenant data confidentiality and staff need-to-know
requirements.description: The system must ensure one customer's data is inaccessible to any other customer, and inaccessible to staff who do not have a business need to access it.
requirements.quote: One customer's data must be inaccessible to another, and to staff without a business need.

requirements.title: Tenant identifier enforced at data access layer
requirements.description: Tenant isolation must be enforced by the data access layer rather than relying on application code paths alone.
requirements.quote: Tenant identifier enforced at the data access layer, not in application code paths alone

requirements.title: Encryption at rest AES-256
requirements.description: Data at rest must be encrypted using AES-256.
requirements.quote: Encryption at rest AES-256; in transit TLS 1.2 minimum

requirements.title: Encryption in transit TLS 1.2 minimum
requirements.description: Data in transit must be protected with TLS at version 1.2 as the minimum.
requirements.quote: Encryption at rest AES-256; in transit TLS 1.2 minimum

requirements.title: No production data in non-production environments
requirements.description: Production data must not be copied into non-production environments.
requirements.quote: Production data must not be copied into non-production environments

requirements.title: Anonymisation before production data leaves production
requirements.description: Where production-like data is needed for testing, it must be anonymised before it leaves the production environment.
requirements.quote: Where production-like data is required for testing, it must be anonymised before it leaves production

requirements.title: Annual penetration test covering tenant isolation
requirements.description: A penetration test report covering tenant isolation must be produced at least annually as evidence.
requirements.quote: Penetration test report covering tenant isolation, at least annually

requirements.title: Evidence that non-production holds no production data
requirements.description: Evidence must be available demonstrating that non-production environments contain no production data.
requirements.quote: Evidence that non-production environments contain no production data

requirements.title: Point-in-time encryption configuration evidence
requirements.description: Encryption configuration evidence must be captured at a point in time within the audit period.
requirements.quote: Encryption configuration evidence at a point in time within the period

requirements.title: Vendor assessment before use and annual review
requirements.description: Any vendor that handles customer data must undergo an assessment before being used and must be reviewed on an annual basis thereafter.
requirements.quote: Vendors handling customer data are assessed before use and reviewed annually.

requirements.title: Security review before contract signature
requirements.description: A security review must be completed before a contract is signed with any vendor that will process customer data.
requirements.quote: Security review before contract signature for any vendor processing customer data

requirements.title: Annual collection and review of vendor SOC 2 reports
requirements.description: A SOC 2 report or equivalent assurance report must be collected from vendors and reviewed each year as evidence of their control environment.
requirements.quote: SOC 2 report or equivalent collected and reviewed annually

requirements.title: Published and maintained subprocessor list
requirements.description: The organisation must publish a list of subprocessors and keep it up to date.
requirements.quote: Subprocessor list published and maintained

requirements.title: 30-day customer notice before engaging a new subprocessor
requirements.description: Customers must be notified 30 days in advance of engaging any new subprocessor.
requirements.quote: customers notified 30 days before a new subprocessor is engaged

requirements.title: Data processing agreement required before sharing personal data
requirements.description: A data processing agreement must be executed and in place before any personal data is shared with a vendor.
requirements.quote: Data processing agreement in place before any personal data is shared

requirements.title: CCPA/CPRA applicability thresholds
requirements.description: CCPA/CPRA obligations apply where the business meets revenue or data volume thresholds and handles personal information of California residents; as a service provider, contractual restrictions apply in addition.
requirements.quote: Applies where the business meets the revenue or data volume thresholds and handles personal information of California residents. As a service provider, contractual restrictions apply in addition.

requirements.title: Right to know covers 12-month lookback
requirements.description: Consumers may request the categories and specific pieces of personal information collected in the 12 months preceding the request.
requirements.quote: Right to know: categories and specific pieces of personal information collected, in the 12 months preceding the request

requirements.title: Right to delete with exceptions
requirements.description: Consumers have a right to deletion of personal information, subject to exceptions including legal obligation and security.
requirements.quote: Right to delete: subject to exceptions including legal obligation and security

requirements.title: Right to correct inaccurate personal information
requirements.description: Consumers may request correction of inaccurate personal information held about them.
requirements.quote: Right to correct inaccurate personal information

requirements.title: Right to opt out of sale or sharing
requirements.description: Consumers may opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information for cross-context behavioural advertising.
requirements.quote: Right to opt out of sale or sharing for cross-context behavioural advertising

requirements.title: Right to limit use of sensitive personal information
requirements.description: Consumers may request that use of their sensitive personal information be limited.
requirements.quote: Right to limit use of sensitive personal information

requirements.title: Non-discrimination for exercising rights
requirements.description: Consumers must not be discriminated against for exercising any of their CCPA/CPRA rights.
requirements.quote: Right to non-discrimination for exercising any of these

requirements.title: Confirm receipt of consumer request within 10 business days
requirements.description: Receipt of a consumer request must be confirmed within 10 business days.
requirements.quote: Confirm receipt within 10 business days

requirements.title: Substantive response within 45 calendar days, one 45-day extension
requirements.description: A substantive response is due within 45 calendar days, extendable once by a further 45 days with notice to the consumer.
requirements.quote: Substantive response within 45 calendar days, extendable once by a further 45 days with notice

requirements.title: Two free requests per consumer per 12 months
requirements.description: Each consumer is entitled to two free requests in any 12-month period.
requirements.quote: Two free requests per consumer per 12-month period

requirements.title: Tiered identity verification certainty
requirements.description: Identity must be verified to a reasonable degree of certainty, with a higher degree of certainty required for deletion requests than for a request to know categories.
requirements.quote: Identity verified to a reasonable degree of certainty; higher certainty for deletion than for a request to know categories

requirements.title: Account-based verification
requirements.description: A password-protected account may be used to verify a consumer's identity where the request is submitted through that account.
requirements.quote: A password-protected account may be used for verification where the request comes through it

requirements.title: Use of personal information limited to contracted services
requirements.description: As a service provider, personal information may be used only to perform the services set out in the contract.
requirements.quote: Personal information may be used only to perform the services in the contract

requirements.title: No sale of personal information
requirements.description: The service provider must not sell personal information.
requirements.quote: No sale of personal information

requirements.title: No combining with information from other sources
requirements.description: Personal information must not be combined with information from other sources except as permitted.
requirements.quote: No combining with information from other sources except as permitted

requirements.title: Assist customer with consumer requests
requirements.description: The service provider is obliged to assist the customer in responding to consumer requests.
requirements.quote: Obligation to assist the customer in responding to consumer requests

requirements.title: Severity classification within 1 hour of detection
requirements.description: Every detected security incident must be assigned a severity classification within one hour of the point of detection.
requirements.quote: Severity classification within 1 hour of detection

requirements.title: Customer notification for incidents affecting their data
requirements.description: Customers must be notified of incidents affecting their data in line with contractual timelines, which are commonly 72 hours or less.
requirements.quote: Customer notification for incidents affecting their data, per contractual timelines, commonly 72 hours or less

requirements.title: Post-incident review within 10 business days
requirements.description: A post-incident review must be completed within 10 business days of the incident, and resulting actions must be tracked through to closure.
requirements.quote: Post-incident review within 10 business days, with actions tracked to closure

requirements.title: CCPA statutory damages for unencrypted personal information
requirements.description: Under CCPA, statutory damages are available for unauthorised access to unencrypted, unredacted personal information where reasonable security was not maintained, creating direct breach liability exposure.
requirements.quote: Statutory damages available for unauthorised access to unencrypted, unredacted personal information where reasonable security was not maintained

requirements.title: Encryption as control and liability limit
requirements.description: Encryption of personal information serves both as a security control and as a limit on statutory breach liability, and must be treated accordingly.
requirements.quote: Encryption is therefore both a control and a liability limit

requirements.title: GDPR supervisory authority notification within 72 hours
requirements.description: Where a personal data breach poses a risk to the rights and freedoms of individuals, the supervisory authority must be notified within 72 hours.
requirements.quote: Supervisory authority within 72 hours where a risk to rights and freedoms exists

requirements.title: GDPR data subject notification without undue delay for high risk
requirements.description: Where a personal data breach presents a high risk to individuals, affected data subjects must be notified without undue delay.
requirements.quote: Data subjects without undue delay where the risk is high

requirements.title: Security-relevant events logged, retained and reviewed
requirements.description: The system must log security-relevant events, retain those logs, and subject them to review.
requirements.quote: Security-relevant events are logged, retained and reviewed.

requirements.title: Log authentication, authorisation failure, privilege change and export events
requirements.description: The system logs authentication events, authorisation failures, privilege changes and data exports.
requirements.quote: Authentication events, authorisation failures, privilege changes and data exports logged

requirements.title: Logs retained for a minimum of 12 months
requirements.description: Log records must be retained for at least 12 months.
requirements.quote: Logs retained 12 months minimum, with 90 days immediately searchable

requirements.title: 90 days of logs immediately searchable
requirements.description: The most recent 90 days of log data must be immediately searchable.
requirements.quote: Logs retained 12 months minimum, with 90 days immediately searchable

requirements.title: Alert on privileged access outside change windows
requirements.description: The system generates alerts when privileged access occurs outside of approved change windows.
requirements.quote: Alerting on privileged access outside change windows

requirements.title: Log integrity protected against modification by application roles
requirements.description: Log integrity is protected such that application roles cannot alter historical log entries.
requirements.quote: Log integrity protected; application roles cannot alter historical entries

requirements.title: Access provisioned before first login with ticket and approver evidence
requirements.description: Access must be provisioned before a user's first login. The system owner is responsible, and evidence must be retained showing the provisioning ticket and the approver.
requirements.quote: | Access provisioning | Before first login | System owner | Yes — ticket and approver |

requirements.title: Quarterly access review with reviewer and date evidence
requirements.description: Access reviews must be performed quarterly by the system owner, with evidence recording the reviewer identity and the review date.
requirements.quote: | Access review | Quarterly | System owner | Yes — reviewer and date |

requirements.title: Deprovisioning within 24 hours of termination
requirements.description: People operations must deprovision access within 24 hours. Evidence must show the gap between termination and revocation.
requirements.quote: | Deprovisioning | 24 hours | People operations | Yes — termination to revocation gap |

requirements.title: Change review before merge with reviewer identity evidence
requirements.description: Engineering must review changes before merge, and evidence must capture the identity of the reviewer.
requirements.quote: | Change review | Before merge | Engineering | Yes — reviewer identity |

requirements.title: Quarterly restore test with date and outcome evidence
requirements.description: Platform operations must perform a restore test quarterly, retaining evidence of the test date and outcome.
requirements.quote: | Restore test | Quarterly | Platform operations | Yes — date and outcome |

requirements.title: Annual vendor review with report and reviewer evidence
requirements.description: Security must review vendors annually, with evidence consisting of the vendor report and the identity of the reviewer.
requirements.quote: | Vendor review | Annually | Security | Yes — report and reviewer |

requirements.title: CCPA request receipt acknowledged within 10 business days
requirements.description: Privacy must acknowledge receipt of a CCPA consumer request within 10 business days, with the acknowledgement retained as evidence.
requirements.quote: | CCPA request receipt | 10 business days | Privacy | Yes — acknowledgement |

requirements.title: CCPA substantive response within 45 days with one extension
requirements.description: Privacy must provide a substantive response to a CCPA request within 45 days, with one extension permitted. Evidence must include the response and its date.
requirements.quote: | CCPA substantive response | 45 days, one extension | Privacy | Yes — response and date |

requirements.title: Incident classification within 1 hour
requirements.description: On-call staff must classify an incident within 1 hour, recording the assigned severity and the classification time as evidence.
requirements.quote: | Incident classification | 1 hour | On-call | Yes — severity and time |

requirements.title: Customer notification per contract, often within 72 hours
requirements.description: Security is responsible for customer notification within the timeframe set by contract, commonly 72 hours, with evidence of the notice issued and its recipients.
requirements.quote: | Customer notification | Per contract, often 72 hours | Security | Yes — notice and recipients |

requirements.title: Low risk tier definition
requirements.description: Data classified as Low risk consists of aggregate product telemetry that contains no identifiers.
requirements.quote: Aggregate product telemetry with no identifiers

requirements.title: Moderate risk tier definition
requirements.description: Data classified as Moderate risk consists of customer account and usage data, and business contact information.
requirements.quote: Customer account and usage data, business contact information

requirements.title: High risk tier definition
requirements.description: Data classified as High risk consists of customer end-user personal information processed on the customer's behalf.
requirements.quote: Customer end-user personal information processed on the customer's behalf

requirements.title: Critical risk tier definition
requirements.description: Data classified as Critical risk is sensitive personal information under CPRA, specifically precise geolocation, government identifiers and account credentials.
requirements.quote: Sensitive personal information under CPRA — precise geolocation, government identifiers, account credentials

requirements.title: Risk tier drives encryption, access approval and retention controls
requirements.description: The assigned risk tier determines the encryption applied to the data, the depth of access approval required, and the retention period.
requirements.quote: Risk tier determines encryption, access approval depth and retention.

requirements.title: SSO and MFA required for all production access
requirements.description: Access to production systems must not be possible without single sign-on and multi-factor authentication; this is a pass/fail success criterion for the implementation.
requirements.quote: No production access without SSO and multi-factor authentication

requirements.title: Quarterly access reviews evidenced for every quarter
requirements.description: Access reviews must be performed quarterly, and evidence of the review must exist for every quarter falling within the audit period.
requirements.quote: Quarterly access reviews evidenced for every quarter in the audit period

requirements.title: Deprovisioning completed within 24 hours
requirements.description: User deprovisioning must occur within 24 hours, and the measurement of deprovisioning timeliness must show no unexplained gaps.
requirements.quote: Deprovisioning within 24 hours, measured with no unexplained gaps

requirements.title: Quarterly restore test using a real restore
requirements.description: Backup restore capability must be tested every quarter, and the test must involve an actual restore rather than a paper or simulated exercise.
requirements.quote: Restore tested quarterly with a real restore

requirements.title: CCPA request acknowledgement within 10 business days
requirements.description: Consumer requests made under CCPA must be acknowledged within 10 business days of receipt.
requirements.quote: CCPA requests acknowledged within 10 business days, answered within 45

requirements.title: CCPA request substantive response within 45 days
requirements.description: Consumer requests made under CCPA must be answered within 45 days.
requirements.quote: CCPA requests acknowledged within 10 business days, answered within 45

requirements.title: Subprocessor list kept current with 30 days' advance notice
requirements.description: The published subprocessor list must be kept up to date, and customers must receive 30 days' notice before any new subprocessor is added.
requirements.quote: Subprocessor list current, with 30 days' notice before any addition

requirements.title: Logs retained 12 months and tamper-evident
requirements.description: Log data must be retained for 12 months and stored in a tamper-evident manner.
requirements.quote: Logs retained 12 months, tamper-evident, and searchable for the recent 90 days

requirements.title: Logs searchable for the most recent 90 days
requirements.description: Log data covering the most recent 90 days must be searchable.
requirements.quote: searchable for the recent 90 days

requirements.title: MVP scope limited to SOC 2 Type II and CCPA trust controls
requirements.description: The initial release scope is constrained to the trust controls required to obtain a SOC 2 Type II report and to comply with CCPA. Features outside those two compliance objectives are out of scope for the MVP.
requirements.quote: **Scope:** MVP — trust controls needed for a SOC 2 Type II report and CCPA compliance

requirements.title: Audit evidence retrievable by query
requirements.description: The platform must be auditable by construction, such that evidence needed for a SOC 2 Type II report can be produced by running a query against the system rather than through a manual collection project.
requirements.quote: Make the platform auditable by construction. Evidence for a Type II report should be a query, not a project.

requirements.title: Reduce annual evidence assembly from six weeks to an afternoon
requirements.description: Evidence assembly currently takes the team six weeks each year using screenshots. The target performance outcome is producing the equivalent evidence within an afternoon.
requirements.quote: Today the team spends six weeks each year assembling screenshots; the target is producing the same evidence in an afternoon.

requirements.title: Release target Q1 2026
requirements.description: The MVP trust controls release is targeted for delivery in Q1 2026.
requirements.quote: **Release Target:** Q1 2026

requirements.title: Every production access grant carries an approval record
requirements.description: Production access grants must always be linked to an approval so that audit sampling never surfaces an unauthorised grant.
requirements.quote: As a system owner, I want every production access grant to carry an approval so that the audit sample never turns up a grant nobody authorised.
requirements.trigger: A production access grant is requested
requirements.happyPath: The requester raises an access request in the ticketing system, the system owner approves it, and the grant is created with a linked approval record available for audit sampling.

requirements.title: Access requests raised in ticketing system only
requirements.description: All access requests must be raised through the ticketing system; access may never be granted directly in a console.
requirements.quote: Access requests raised in the ticketing system, never granted directly in a console

requirements.title: Approver must be system owner and separate from requester
requirements.description: The approver of an access request must be the system owner and must be a different person from the requester. Self-approval is rejected.
requirements.quote: Approver must be the system owner and must differ from the requester; self-approval rejected

requirements.title: Default grant expiry of 90 days
requirements.description: Access grants expire by default after 90 days.
requirements.quote: Grants carry an expiry: 90 days default, 7 days for elevated production roles

requirements.title: Elevated production role grants expire in 7 days
requirements.description: Grants for elevated production roles carry a shortened expiry of 7 days.
requirements.quote: Grants carry an expiry: 90 days default, 7 days for elevated production roles

requirements.title: Automatic revocation on expiry with fresh-approval renewal
requirements.description: Grant expiry triggers automatic revocation of access. Renewal is possible only through a path that requires a fresh approval.
requirements.quote: Expiry triggers automatic revocation, with a renewal path requiring fresh approval

requirements.title: Sealed and alarmed break-glass account
requirements.description: A break-glass account is maintained for outage recovery; it is kept sealed and its use raises an alarm.
requirements.quote: Break-glass account exists for outage recovery, sealed and alarmed on use

requirements.title: No unapproved production access path
requirements.description: There must be no way to grant production access without a linked approval record.
requirements.quote: No path exists to grant production access without a linked approval record

requirements.title: Expired grants revoked within 1 hour
requirements.description: An expired access grant must be revoked within 1 hour of its expiry time.
requirements.quote: An expired grant revokes within 1 hour of expiry

requirements.title: Break-glass use pages security on-call within 60 seconds
requirements.description: Use of the break-glass account must raise a page to the security on-call within 60 seconds.
requirements.quote: Break-glass use raises a page to the security on-call within 60 seconds

requirements.title: Grant export for a date range
requirements.description: The system must export all grants for a given date range including requester, approver, justification and expiry.
requirements.quote: Export of all grants for a date range produces requester, approver, justification and expiry

requirements.title: Quarterly access review produces auditor-ready evidence
requirements.description: The compliance manager runs a quarterly access review that generates evidence in the format required by the auditor, avoiding spreadsheet reformatting during the audit window.
requirements.quote: As a compliance manager, I want reviews to produce evidence in the format the auditor wants, so that we are not reformatting spreadsheets in the audit window.
requirements.trigger: Start of the quarterly access review cycle
requirements.happyPath: A review is generated per system, the reviewer decides on each line, revocations execute from the review, and the review is closed producing an auditor-ready export retained for the audit period.

requirements.title: Per-system review listing accounts, roles and last login
requirements.description: Access reviews are generated per system and list every account with its role and last login date.
requirements.quote: Review generated per system, listing every account with role and last login

requirements.title: Line-by-line reviewer decision, no bulk-approve
requirements.description: The reviewer must action every line of the review with keep, reduce or revoke; no bulk-approve capability is offered.
requirements.quote: Reviewer must action every line: keep, reduce or revoke; bulk-approve is not offered

requirements.title: Revocations execute directly from the review
requirements.description: Revocation decisions are executed from within the review itself rather than requiring a separate ticket.
requirements.quote: Revocations execute from the review itself, not through a separate ticket

requirements.title: Dormant accounts flagged after 90 days without login
requirements.description: Accounts with no login for 90 days are flagged within the access review.
requirements.quote: Accounts with no login in 90 days flagged in the review

requirements.title: Review closure requires all lines decided
requirements.description: A review may be closed only once every line carries a decision.
requirements.quote: Review closed only when every line has a decision

requirements.title: Undecided lines block review closure
requirements.description: The system must prevent closure of a review that still contains undecided lines.
requirements.quote: Review cannot be closed with undecided lines

requirements.title: Review-initiated revocation effective within 1 hour
requirements.description: A revocation triggered from an access review must take effect within 1 hour.
requirements.quote: Revocation from a review takes effect within 1 hour

requirements.title: Review export contents
requirements.description: The review export must include the reviewer identity, the decision for each line, and the closure date.
requirements.quote: Export includes reviewer identity, decision per line, and closure date

requirements.title: Review evidence retained for the full audit period
requirements.description: Access review evidence must be retained for the full audit period and must not be overwritten by the following quarter's review.
requirements.quote: Evidence retained for the full audit period, not overwritten by the next quarter

requirements.title: Tenant scoping enforced below the application layer
requirements.description: Security engineers require tenant scoping to be enforced beneath the application so that a missing filter in an application query cannot expose another customer's data.
requirements.quote: As a security engineer, I want tenant scoping enforced below the application so that a missing filter in a query cannot leak another customer's data.
requirements.trigger: A query is issued against customer data
requirements.happyPath: The data layer resolves the tenant context, scopes the query to that tenant, and rejects any query lacking context regardless of application-level filtering.

requirements.title: Mandatory tenant context on every query
requirements.description: Every query must carry a tenant context. Queries submitted without a tenant context are rejected at the data layer.
requirements.quote: Every query carries a tenant context; queries without one are rejected at the data layer

requirements.title: Row-level security enforced in the database
requirements.description: Row-level security must be enforced in the database itself, not relied upon solely in application code.
requirements.quote: Row-level security enforced in the database, not only in application code

requirements.title: Cross-tenant queries restricted to named internal reporting roles
requirements.description: Cross-tenant queries are permitted only for named internal reporting roles, and every such query is logged.
requirements.quote: Cross-tenant queries permitted only for named internal reporting roles, and always logged

requirements.title: Automated cross-tenant read test on every deployment
requirements.description: An automated test must assert that a request authenticated as tenant A cannot read tenant B data, and it must run on every deployment.
requirements.quote: Automated test asserting that a request authenticated as tenant A cannot read tenant B, run on every deployment

requirements.title: Queries without tenant context fail closed and are logged
requirements.description: When a query lacks tenant context, the system fails closed (denies the query) and records the failure in a log.
requirements.quote: A query without tenant context fails closed, and the failure is logged

requirements.title: Cross-tenant test blocks release on failure
requirements.description: The cross-tenant isolation test executes on every deployment and a failing result blocks the release.
requirements.quote: The cross-tenant test runs on every deployment and blocks release on failure

requirements.title: Annual penetration test covers tenant isolation
requirements.description: A penetration test performed annually must explicitly cover tenant isolation.
requirements.quote: Annual penetration test covers tenant isolation explicitly

requirements.title: Support tools cannot read customer content outside an audited impersonation session
requirements.description: No support tool may read customer content unless the access occurs within an audited impersonation session.
requirements.quote: No support tool can read customer content without an audited impersonation session

requirements.title: Support engineer views customer view during bug investigation
requirements.description: A support engineer needs to see the customer's view when a bug is reported, without impersonation becoming an unmonitored route into customer data.
requirements.quote: As a support engineer, I want to see what the customer sees when they report a bug, without that becoming an unmonitored door into their data.
requirements.happyPath: The engineer opens an impersonation session linked to the customer support ticket, views the customer's screen read-only for up to 2 hours, and every action is logged and attributed to the engineer.

requirements.title: Impersonation requires a customer-linked support ticket
requirements.description: An impersonation session may only be started when it is linked to a customer support ticket.
requirements.quote: Impersonation requires a customer-linked support ticket

requirements.title: Impersonation session limited to 2 hours and read-only by default
requirements.description: Impersonation sessions are capped at 2 hours in duration and are read-only unless otherwise authorised.
requirements.quote: Session limited to 2 hours and read-only by default

requirements.title: Write access during impersonation requires a second approver
requirements.description: Any write access performed during an impersonation session must be approved by a second approver.
requirements.quote: Write access during impersonation requires a second approver

requirements.title: Customer-visible impersonation session log
requirements.description: Customer administrators can view a log of impersonation sessions carried out on their account.
requirements.quote: Customer administrators can see a log of impersonation sessions on their account

requirements.title: Impersonation actions attributed to the engineer
requirements.description: Every action performed during an impersonation session is attributed to the support engineer rather than to the customer.
requirements.quote: Every action during impersonation attributed to the engineer, not the customer

requirements.title: Impersonation refused without a ticket reference
requirements.description: An attempt to start an impersonation session that does not include a ticket reference is refused.
requirements.quote: Impersonation without a ticket reference is refused

requirements.title: Impersonation log content requirements
requirements.description: The customer-visible impersonation log must display the engineer, the session start and end time, and the reason for the session.
requirements.quote: Customer-visible log shows engineer, start and end time, and reason

requirements.title: Impersonation actions distinguishable in the audit trail
requirements.description: Actions taken during an impersonation session must be distinguishable from the customer's own actions within the audit trail.
requirements.quote: Actions taken are distinguishable from the customer's own in the audit trail

requirements.title: Track consumer privacy requests against statutory clocks
requirements.description: A privacy analyst must be able to track incoming consumer requests against statutory deadlines so the 45-day CCPA fulfilment deadline is never missed.
requirements.quote: As a privacy analyst, I want consumer requests tracked against statutory clocks so that we never miss the 45-day deadline.
requirements.trigger: A consumer privacy request is received
requirements.happyPath: Request is intaken, acknowledged, verified, and fulfilled within the 45-day statutory clock, with the countdown visible throughout.

requirements.title: Multi-channel privacy request intake
requirements.description: The system must accept consumer privacy requests through a web form, a toll-free telephone number, and email sent to a published address.
requirements.quote: Intake channels: web form, toll-free number, and email to a published address

requirements.title: Automatic acknowledgement within 10 business days
requirements.description: Every consumer request must receive an automatically issued acknowledgement no later than 10 business days after receipt.
requirements.quote: Acknowledgement issued within 10 business days, automatically

requirements.title: Supported consumer request types
requirements.description: The system must support the request types: know categories, know specific pieces, delete, correct, opt out of sale or sharing, and limit sensitive use.
requirements.quote: Request types: know categories, know specific pieces, delete, correct, opt out of sale or sharing, limit sensitive use

requirements.title: Tiered identity verification by request type
requirements.description: Verification strength must be tiered according to request type: a lower level for requests to know categories, and a higher level for deletion and requests for specific pieces of information.
requirements.quote: Verification tiered by request type: lower for categories, higher for deletion and specific pieces

requirements.title: Deletion cascade to backups on a documented, disclosed schedule
requirements.description: Deletions propagate to backup copies according to a documented schedule rather than immediately, and that schedule must be disclosed.
requirements.quote: Deletion cascades to backups on a documented schedule rather than immediately, with the schedule disclosed

requirements.title: Two free requests per consumer per 12 months
requirements.description: The system must track that each consumer is entitled to two free requests in any 12-month period and flag any subsequent requests beyond that allowance.
requirements.quote: Two free requests per consumer per 12 months tracked, with subsequent requests flagged

requirements.title: Countdown display and day-35 escalation
requirements.description: Every open request must display a countdown to the statutory deadline, and the request must escalate at day 35.
requirements.quote: Countdown visible on every open request; escalation at day 35

requirements.title: Extension requires evidence of pre-day-45 notification
requirements.description: An extension to the response deadline may only be granted where there is evidence the consumer was notified before day 45.
requirements.quote: Extension requires evidence the consumer was notified before day 45

requirements.title: Deletion manifest with named exceptions
requirements.description: Each deletion must produce a manifest listing what was deleted and what was retained under an exception, naming the exception relied upon.
requirements.quote: Deletion produces a manifest of what was deleted and what was retained under an exception, with the exception named

requirements.title: Service provider requests routed to the customer
requirements.description: Requests received while acting as a service provider must be routed to the customer (controller) rather than answered directly.
requirements.quote: Requests arriving as a service provider are routed to the customer, not answered directly

requirements.title: Consumer opt-out honoured across all contexts
requirements.description: A consumer wants an opt-out set in one place to be honoured everywhere, not only in the context where it was set.
requirements.quote: As a consumer, I want my opt-out honoured everywhere, not just where I set it.
requirements.trigger: Consumer submits an opt-out of sale or sharing
requirements.happyPath: Opt-out is stored against the consumer identity and propagated to all downstream integrations so it is honoured in every context.

requirements.title: Opt-out state stored against consumer identity
requirements.description: Opt-out state must be persisted against the consumer identity rather than the browsing session.
requirements.quote: Opt-out state stored against the consumer identity, not the session

requirements.title: Honour Global Privacy Control signal
requirements.description: The Global Privacy Control browser signal must be treated as a valid opt-out request.
requirements.quote: Global Privacy Control signal honoured as a valid opt-out

requirements.title: Opt-out propagation within 24 hours
requirements.description: An opt-out must propagate to advertising and analytics integrations within 24 hours of being recorded.
requirements.quote: Opt-out propagates to advertising and analytics integrations within 24 hours

requirements.title: Limit use of sensitive personal information on request
requirements.description: Use of sensitive personal information must be limited when a consumer requests it, with a defined list of the uses that remain permitted.
requirements.quote: Sensitive personal information use limited on request, with a defined list of what remains permitted

requirements.title: Opt-out persists across logout, device change and re-registration
requirements.description: A recorded opt-out must survive logout, a change of device, and re-registration using the same identifier.
requirements.quote: Opt-out survives logout, device change and re-registration with the same identifier

requirements.title: Record GPC as the opt-out source
requirements.description: When the Global Privacy Control signal triggered the opt-out, GPC must be recorded as the source of that opt-out.
requirements.quote: GPC signal recorded as the source when it is what triggered the opt-out

requirements.title: Downstream propagation evidenced by integration acknowledgement
requirements.description: Propagation of an opt-out to each downstream integration must be evidenced by an acknowledgement received from that integration.
requirements.quote: Downstream propagation evidenced by an acknowledgement from each integration

requirements.title: Continuous control evidence collection for Type II period
requirements.description: The system must collect control evidence continuously throughout the audit period so that a SOC 2 Type II observation window is fully covered without an end-of-period effort.
requirements.quote: As a compliance manager, I want control evidence collected continuously so that a Type II period is covered without a scramble at the end.
requirements.trigger: Start of an audit (Type II) observation period
requirements.happyPath: Collectors run on schedule across the period, artefacts accumulate per control, gaps are flagged in-period, and the compliance manager exports complete evidence at audit time.

requirements.title: Evidence collectors for defined control areas
requirements.description: The system must provide evidence collectors covering access grants, access reviews, deprovisioning timing, change approvals, restore tests, vendor reviews and incident records.
requirements.quote: Evidence collectors for: access grants, access reviews, deprovisioning timing, change approvals, restore tests, vendor reviews, incident records

requirements.title: Scheduled collection with timestamped artefacts
requirements.description: Each evidence collector must run on a defined schedule and store a timestamped artefact of what it collected.
requirements.quote: Each collector runs on a schedule and stores a timestamped artefact

requirements.title: In-period evidence gap surfacing
requirements.description: Evidence gaps must be surfaced when they occur rather than at audit time; for example, a quarter with no access review must be flagged within that quarter.
requirements.quote: Gaps are surfaced as they occur, not discovered at audit — a quarter with no access review is flagged in that quarter

requirements.title: Evidence retention: audit period plus one year
requirements.description: Collected evidence must be retained for the full audit period plus one additional year.
requirements.quote: Evidence retained for the full audit period plus one year

requirements.title: Per-control evidence coverage dashboard
requirements.description: A dashboard must show, for each control, whether evidence exists for every period within the audit window.
requirements.quote: Dashboard shows, per control, whether evidence exists for every period in the audit window

requirements.title: Missing evidence period visible within 7 days
requirements.description: A period with missing evidence must become visible within 7 days of that period closing.
requirements.quote: A missing period is visible within 7 days of the period closing

requirements.title: Structured evidence export with index
requirements.description: Evidence export must produce a structured archive accompanied by an index.
requirements.quote: Evidence export produces a structured archive with an index

requirements.title: Evidence artefacts immutable after collection
requirements.description: Once collected, an evidence artefact must not be editable by any means.
requirements.quote: No evidence artefact can be edited after collection

requirements.title: Centralised security event logging with defensible retention
requirements.description: Security-relevant events must be logged in a single place with a retention period that can be defended to an auditor.
requirements.quote: As a security engineer, I want security-relevant events logged in one place with a retention I can defend.
requirements.trigger: A security-relevant event occurs in the system
requirements.happyPath: The event is written to the central append-only log, retained per policy, and is searchable by the security engineer.

requirements.title: Logged security event types
requirements.description: The audit log must capture authentication, authorisation failure, privilege change, data export, impersonation, and configuration change events.
requirements.quote: Logged: authentication, authorisation failure, privilege change, data export, impersonation, configuration change

requirements.title: Audit log retention of 12 months
requirements.description: Audit log entries must be retained for 12 months.
requirements.quote: Retention 12 months; recent 90 days searchable in under 5 seconds

requirements.title: Append-only log integrity
requirements.description: Logs must be append-only, with no application role able to modify log history.
requirements.quote: Log integrity: append-only, with no application role able to modify history

requirements.title: Alerting on privileged access outside a change window
requirements.description: The system must alert when privileged access occurs outside an approved change window.
requirements.quote: Alerting on privileged access outside a change window

requirements.title: 90-day log search under 5 seconds
requirements.description: A search across the most recent 90 days of log data must return results in under 5 seconds.
requirements.quote: Search across 90 days returns in under 5 seconds

requirements.title: No path modifies an existing log entry
requirements.description: No API or console path may modify an existing log entry.
requirements.quote: No API or console path modifies an existing log entry

requirements.title: Privileged access alert within 5 minutes
requirements.description: An alert must fire within 5 minutes of privileged access occurring outside a change window.
requirements.quote: Alert fires within 5 minutes of privileged access outside a window

requirements.title: Daily automated backup with 35-day retention
requirements.description: Backups of platform data must run automatically every day and be retained for 35 days.
requirements.quote: Daily automated backup, 35-day retention

requirements.title: Quarterly restore test in isolated environment
requirements.description: Every quarter, backups must be restored into an isolated environment and data integrity verified against known records.
requirements.quote: Quarterly restore into an isolated environment, with data integrity verified against known records

requirements.title: Restore time measured against 4-hour RTO
requirements.description: The duration of each restore must be measured and compared against the 4-hour recovery time objective.
requirements.quote: Restore time measured and compared against the 4-hour recovery time objective

requirements.title: Backup encryption keys separated from production key hierarchy
requirements.description: Backups must be encrypted using keys held separately from the production key hierarchy.
requirements.quote: Backup encryption with keys separate from the production key hierarchy

requirements.title: Restore test record captures date, duration and outcome
requirements.description: Each restore test must be recorded with the date it ran, how long it took, and the verification outcome.
requirements.quote: Restore test recorded with date, duration, and verification outcome

requirements.title: Failed restore test raises an incident
requirements.description: A restore test that fails must raise an incident and must not be silently retried.
requirements.quote: A failed restore test raises an incident rather than being retried silently

requirements.title: Recovery point verified within 1-hour objective
requirements.description: Verification must confirm the recovery point falls within the 1-hour recovery point objective.
requirements.quote: Recovery point verified within the 1-hour objective

requirements.title: Platform engineer validates restores for real
requirements.description: A platform engineer needs restores actually exercised, not assumed, so that recoverability is proven rather than hypothetical.
requirements.quote: As a platform engineer, I want restores tested for real, because a backup that has never been restored is a hypothesis.
requirements.happyPath: The engineer restores a daily backup into an isolated environment, verifies data integrity against known records, measures restore time against the 4-hour RTO, and records the date, duration and verification outcome.

requirements.title: API response time at 95th percentile under 300ms
requirements.description: The system's API must respond in under 300 milliseconds measured at the 95th percentile.
requirements.quote: API response under 300ms at the 95th percentile

requirements.title: Log search over 90 days completes in under 5 seconds
requirements.description: Searching logs spanning a 90-day window must return results in less than 5 seconds.
requirements.quote: Log search over 90 days under 5 seconds

requirements.title: 12-month evidence export completes in under 10 minutes
requirements.description: Exporting evidence covering a 12-month period must complete in less than 10 minutes.
requirements.quote: Evidence export for a 12-month period under 10 minutes

requirements.title: SSO with MFA required for all internal access
requirements.description: All internal access to the system must be authenticated through single sign-on with multi-factor authentication.
requirements.quote: SSO with multi-factor authentication for all internal access

requirements.title: Encryption at rest with AES-256
requirements.description: Data stored at rest must be encrypted using AES-256.
requirements.quote: Encryption at rest AES-256, in transit TLS 1.2 minimum

requirements.title: Encryption in transit with TLS 1.2 minimum
requirements.description: Data in transit must be protected with TLS at version 1.2 or higher.
requirements.quote: Encryption at rest AES-256, in transit TLS 1.2 minimum

requirements.title: Secrets held in a managed store, never in version control
requirements.description: All secrets must be kept in a managed secrets store and must never appear in source code or in environment files committed to version control.
requirements.quote: Secrets in a managed store, never in source or environment files committed to version control

requirements.title: Dependency scanning on every build with critical findings blocking release
requirements.description: Every build must run dependency scanning, and any critical finding blocks the release from proceeding.
requirements.quote: Dependency scanning on every build, with critical findings blocking release

requirements.title: 99.9% monthly uptime target
requirements.description: The service must achieve at least 99.9% uptime measured monthly. Announced maintenance windows are excluded from the uptime calculation.
requirements.quote: 99.9% monthly uptime excluding announced maintenance

requirements.title: Recovery time objective of 4 hours
requirements.description: Following a disruption, service must be restored within a recovery time objective of 4 hours.
requirements.quote: Recovery time objective 4 hours, recovery point objective 1 hour

requirements.title: Recovery point objective of 1 hour
requirements.description: Backup and replication must limit maximum tolerable data loss to 1 hour, meeting a recovery point objective of 1 hour.
requirements.quote: Recovery time objective 4 hours, recovery point objective 1 hour

requirements.title: 24/7 on-call rota with documented escalation path
requirements.description: A round-the-clock on-call rota must be maintained, supported by a documented escalation path for incidents.
requirements.quote: On-call rota 24/7 with a documented escalation path

requirements.title: Per-customer data residency selection between US and EU
requirements.description: The system must allow data residency to be selected on a per-customer basis, with US and EU as the available regions.
requirements.quote: Data residency selectable per customer between US and EU

requirements.title: Production data must be anonymised before use in non-production
requirements.description: Production data must never be copied into non-production environments unless it has first been anonymised.
requirements.quote: Production data never copied to non-production without anonymisation

requirements.title: Per-customer configurable retention within regulatory limits
requirements.description: Data retention periods must be configurable for each customer, constrained to stay within applicable regulatory limits.
requirements.quote: Retention configurable per customer within regulatory limits

requirements.title: FedRAMP authorisation excluded from MVP scope
requirements.description: FedRAMP authorisation is explicitly out of scope for the MVP release; no FedRAMP authorisation work or claims are part of the initial delivery.
requirements.quote:
- FedRAMP authorisation
- HITRUST certification

requirements.title: HITRUST certification excluded from MVP scope
requirements.description: HITRUST certification is explicitly out of scope for the MVP release.
requirements.quote:
- FedRAMP authorisation
- HITRUST certification

requirements.title: Customer-managed encryption keys excluded from MVP scope
requirements.description: The MVP will not support customer-managed encryption keys; encryption key management remains provider-controlled for the initial release.
requirements.quote: - Customer-managed encryption keys

requirements.title: Automated GDPR data subject request fulfilment excluded from MVP scope
requirements.description: Automated fulfilment of data subject requests for GDPR is out of scope for the MVP; only the CCPA workflow is delivered, and GDPR-specific automation beyond that workflow is excluded.
requirements.quote: Automated data subject request fulfilment for GDPR beyond the CCPA workflow

requirements.title: Obtain a SOC 2 Type II report to support enterprise sales
requirements.description: The platform must be able to present a SOC 2 Type II report during customer security reviews. The absence of such a report has directly caused enterprise opportunities to stall (three of the last eight).
requirements.quote: three of the last eight enterprise opportunities stalled because there was no SOC 2 Type II report

requirements.title: Support a signable CCPA data processing addendum
requirements.description: The organisation must be able to execute a CCPA data processing addendum as presented by enterprise customers; two recent opportunities required a DPA the team could not sign as written.
requirements.quote: two required a CCPA data processing addendum the team could not sign as written

requirements.title: Programme objective: make the platform sellable to enterprise buyers
requirements.description: The enterprise readiness programme exists to remove security-review blockers so the collaboration platform can be sold to mid-market and enterprise customers.
requirements.quote: The programme exists to make the platform sellable to enterprise buyers.

requirements.title: Success measured by security review cycle time, not certification
requirements.description: Programme success is measured by the elapsed time required to clear a customer security review rather than by obtaining a certificate. The current baseline is 6 to 11 weeks.
requirements.quote: The measure is not the certificate; it is the time it takes to clear a customer security review, currently 6 to 11 weeks.

requirements.title: SOC 2 Type II with 12-month observation period
requirements.description: Northwind must achieve a SOC 2 Type II attestation, which most enterprise buyers require, and the audit must cover a 12-month observation period.
requirements.quote: SOC 2 Type II required by most enterprise buyers, with a 12-month observation period expected

requirements.title: CCPA applicability to end-user populations
requirements.description: CCPA obligations apply to Northwind because California residents are present in customer end-user populations and Northwind meets the CCPA revenue threshold.
requirements.quote: CCPA applies: California residents in customer end-user populations, and Northwind meets the revenue threshold

requirements.title: GDPR compliance handled through standard contractual clauses
requirements.description: GDPR applies to Northwind's EU customers, and transfers/processing are currently addressed through standard contractual clauses.
requirements.quote: GDPR applies to EU customers, currently handled through standard contractual clauses

requirements.title: ISO 27001 interest not yet committed
requirements.description: Two customers have asked about ISO 27001 certification; Northwind has not committed to pursuing it.
requirements.quote: Two customers have asked about ISO 27001; not yet committed

requirements.title: Annual penetration test contractual obligation
requirements.description: Four enterprise contracts require Northwind to conduct a penetration test annually.
requirements.quote: Annual penetration test required by four enterprise contracts

requirements.title: EU data residency region
requirements.description: The platform currently operates in a single US region; EU customers are requesting an EU data residency region.
requirements.quote: Data residency: single US region today; EU customers asking for an EU region

requirements.title: Support customer organisations from 5 to 4,000 seats
requirements.description: The platform serves 2,400 customer organisations whose sizes range from 5 seats to 4,000 seats, so it must accommodate that span of tenant sizes.
requirements.quote: 2,400 customer organisations, from 5 seats to 4,000

requirements.title: Newly established security and compliance function
requirements.description: Northwind had no formal security function until nine months ago; the function now consists of two security engineers and a compliance manager, which constrains compliance capacity.
requirements.quote: No formal security function until nine months ago; now two security engineers and a compliance manager

requirements.title: Self-serve signup with email verification and card payment
requirements.description: Small teams (5-50 seats) must be able to purchase and onboard without procurement, by signing up with an email address, verifying it, and paying by credit card.
requirements.quote: Sign up with email, verify, pay by card
requirements.actor: Self-serve small team customer (account setup user)
requirements.trigger: A small team of 5-50 seats decides to purchase the product without a procurement process
requirements.happyPath: User signs up with email, verifies the address, pays by card, accepts the standard terms including the privacy notice, and begins using the product immediately

requirements.title: Standard terms and privacy notice accepted at signup
requirements.description: Self-serve customers accept the standard terms, including the privacy notice, as part of the signup flow rather than through a negotiated contract.
requirements.quote: Accept standard terms including the privacy notice

requirements.title: No negotiated data processing addendum for self-serve segment
requirements.description: The self-serve small team segment operates without a negotiated data processing addendum; only standard terms accepted at signup apply.
requirements.quote: No data processing addendum negotiated

requirements.title: Self-serve customers bypass security review
requirements.description: Self-serve small team customers do not perform a security review; they accept the terms by clicking through, meaning no external assurance step gates their onboarding.
requirements.quote: No security review; they click through the terms

requirements.title: Immediate product access after signup
requirements.description: After signup, verification, payment and terms acceptance, the customer can begin using the product immediately with no waiting period.
requirements.quote: Begin using the product immediately

requirements.title: Onboarding completes in minutes for self-serve customers
requirements.description: The expected end-to-end onboarding duration for the self-serve small team persona is minutes.
requirements.quote: Expected onboarding: minutes

requirements.title: Support impersonation currently requires no ticket
requirements.description: For the self-serve segment, support staff use impersonation freely for troubleshooting, with no ticket reference required as a precondition today.
requirements.quote: Support impersonation used freely for troubleshooting, currently without a ticket requirement

requirements.title: Self-serve segment drives majority of impersonation volume
requirements.description: While the self-serve persona presents no unusual risk factors, it accounts for the majority of support impersonation volume, concentrating impersonation risk in this segment.
requirements.quote: Risk factors: none unusual, but they are the majority of the support impersonation volume

requirements.title: Self-serve users may become CCPA requesters
requirements.description: Self-serve small team customers carry no compliance obligation until one of them submits a CCPA consumer rights request, at which point the compliance process applies.
requirements.quote: Compliance story: none, until one of them becomes a CCPA requester

requirements.title: Self-serve tenant data scope
requirements.description: Data held for the self-serve persona consists of business contact information and customer-uploaded content.
requirements.quote: Data: business contact information and content they upload

requirements.title: Single support contact is the account setup user
requirements.description: For self-serve small team accounts, the support contact is whoever set up the account, with no designated administrator or security contact.
requirements.quote: Support contact: whoever set up the account

requirements.title: Mid-market segment accounts for 28% of customers and 34% of revenue
requirements.description: The mid-market buyer persona represents 28% of the customer base and 34% of revenue, and must be weighted accordingly when prioritising compliance investment.
requirements.quote: ### Persona 2: Mid-Market Buyer (28% of customers, 34% of revenue)

requirements.title: Mid-market profile: 50-500 seats with procurement and a security questionnaire
requirements.description: Mid-market accounts are defined as 50-500 seats, involve a procurement function, and require completion of a security questionnaire before purchase.
requirements.quote: - 50-500 seats, procurement involved, a security questionnaire

requirements.title: Security questionnaires are 80-150 questions delivered as a spreadsheet
requirements.description: The system and process must support inbound security questionnaires typically containing 80-150 questions, received in spreadsheet format.
requirements.quote: - Questionnaire typically 80-150 questions, sent as a spreadsheet

requirements.title: Mid-market decision makers are the IT director and procurement analyst
requirements.description: Compliance materials for mid-market deals are addressed to an IT director and a procurement analyst as the decision makers.
requirements.quote: - Decision makers: IT director and a procurement analyst

requirements.title: Mid-market data scope includes employee personal information and customer data
requirements.description: Mid-market customers store employee personal information, uploaded documents, and sometimes their own customers' data, which sets the privacy scope for these accounts.
requirements.quote: - Data: employee personal information, uploaded documents, sometimes customer data of their own

requirements.title: Manual questionnaire response consumes 8-15 hours per deal
requirements.description: Security questionnaires are currently answered manually, costing 8-15 hours of effort per deal.
requirements.quote: - Security questionnaire answered manually, taking 8-15 hours per deal

requirements.title: Data processing addendum is on the buyer's paper and requires legal review
requirements.description: For mid-market deals the DPA is usually presented on the buyer's paper and must go through internal legal review before signature.
requirements.quote: - Data processing addendum usually the buyer's paper, requiring legal review

requirements.title: Risk of inconsistent questionnaire answers given from memory
requirements.description: Because questionnaire answers are produced from memory rather than a controlled source, answers are inconsistent across questionnaires — a recognised risk factor for mid-market deals.
requirements.quote: - Risk factors: inconsistent answers across questionnaires, because they are answered from memory

requirements.title: Expected mid-market timeline is 2-4 weeks from questionnaire to signature
requirements.description: The compliance and contracting cycle for mid-market deals is expected to complete within 2-4 weeks from receipt of the questionnaire to contract signature.
requirements.quote: - Expected timeline: 2-4 weeks from questionnaire to signature

requirements.title: No specific post-signature monitoring for mid-market accounts
requirements.description: Mid-market accounts have no specific ongoing compliance monitoring obligation after contract signature.
requirements.quote: - Monitoring: none specific after signature

requirements.title: Compliance manager completes a mid-market security questionnaire
requirements.description: End-to-end journey in which sales forwards the buyer's questionnaire to the compliance manager, who assembles the answers by chasing engineers for technical specifics, before the deal progresses to legal review.
requirements.quote:
1. Sales sends the questionnaire to the compliance manager
2. Compliance manager assembles answers, chasing engineers for specifics
